reviews.review:
If you have ever wanted to stride through the battlefields of Warhammer 40K then this game is for you.

There aren't enough games like this for the 40K universe and this is one of the best entries in the genre. The action is intense and fast paced, mixing the feeling of being a nigh invincible Space Marine with the sense of being overwhelmed by Orks in their untold horde as you fight to protect vital Imperial assets from the ravages of the Ork WAAAGH!

The atmosphere of the game is spot on and you get a real sense of the desperation of the characters involved as you and they struggle to survive amidst the carnage and ruin of the battlefield.

Ultimately the only thing that I found wanting was the lack of other Space Marines. Save for a few instances you are alone with two others against the enemy. It would have been nice to have fought alongside others and some of the more powerful warmachines of the Adeptus Astartes as well.

The gameplay is rudimentary but that doesn't detract from the experience as you are often too busy trying to stem the tide of enemies to really pay attention to the controls and they become second nature while you execute devastating melee attacks and furious barrages of bolter fire to push the Orks back and there are many minor mechanics such as suicide squiggs and Orks holding up sewer grates that add little tactical choices to mix up the combat.

All in all I would say play this game if you like 40K and definitely play this game if you love Space Marines.

So I wasn't sure how well a 3rd person shooter of the Warhammer series was going to turn out.  But I was actually very pleased with how it did turn out.

The story is pretty good and so is the game play, I enjoyed evry minute of the campaign and am kinda sad I finished it.  I could go into more detail, but that would probably bore people and spoil the fun for others, so short and sweet is the way to go!

Multiplayer is a bit dead, as its a older game, but I have played a few online co-op mathes thus far and it has been challenging and enjoyable.

If you like the Warhammer series, then you should definitly pick this game up as it's well worth it.

Simple, fast action game taken place in the warhammer universum. I like it very much.
Fighting on the side of the space marines is always fun.
Kill the orcs! Purge the unclean!
FOR THE EMPEROR!

The action in this game is great everything feels meaty and heavy just as it should. It also doesn't believe in cover for better or for worse. My only negative is no one plays the multiplayer which is a damn shame and that there most likely won't be a second one.
